exposure: training on benefits of natural vaginal delivery
combined optimism and natural vaginal delivery training
outcome: intention to choose type of delivery
cohort: 96 primiparous women in Mashhad, Iran, with 30-34 weeks of pregnancy and no medical indication for C-section.
finding: Optimism training combined with training the benefits of natural childbirth significantly improved positive attitudes towards natural delivery compared to natural delivery benefits training alone, but had no effect on the intention to choose or the actual selection of delivery type.
mod_finding: Combined optimism training and education on natural delivery benefits increased positive attitudes towards natural vaginal delivery, but neither intervention significantly influenced mothers' intentions or actual choice regarding the type of birth.
